Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced and implicitly relied on an auto-generated DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet that incorrectly stated Education of a Prince (1927) originated from the United States. This reflects inadequate verification and overreliance on search-result metadata instead of opening authoritative sources (e.g., the Wikipedia/IMDb pages visible in results), introducing misinformation that could lead to a wrong conclusion about the films’ countries.
